# What does this PR do?
With `hfsdp_param_gather_overlap`, a DP-Outer bucket larger than the remaining prefetch size could end the DP-Inner prefetch window partway through the next FSDP unit. The rest of that unit was then gathered only at its own pre-forward hook, on the critical path. The window now finishes the FSDP unit it ends inside, which exceeds the size by at most one unit and never walks further.

Should be fixed before merge. Logic might not be as simple as just lookahead.

@cspades

> Could you remind me what this fix "looks" like? Like say we unfortunately have some remainder buckets that were left behind in the prefetch so we have to on-the-fly AG them when their layer is run, is it basically just that new NCCL group call that is a nontrivial waste of time and is obviously badly overlapped?

Yeah.. the leftover buckets get all-gathered at their unit's pre-fwd hook. Profiles showed it as exposed DP-Inner all-gather time in forward, and the fix saved significant time in benchmarks (~3+% in one important case).

> If the above is the case, is this also a problem for inner-DP all-gather? Wondering if we should just update the logic to end on clean unit boundaries in _extend_by_prefetch_size instead of this HFSDP + pipeline-specific fix.

It can happen without HFSDP too, but I kept it to the case where I measured it and where DP-outer already gathers whole units. Doing it everywhere changes prefetch memory for every FSDP config, so I'd rather do that as a separate follow-up if anything.

> I think a quick mention in the config docstrings and documentation that suggested_communication_unit_size is an approximation in these case(s)?

Added to both config docstrings - the prefetch size is a lower bound there.

Codecov's line data for this file looks inconsistent (e.g. 4707–4718 hit but 4705–4706 above them in the same block missed). Running the new tests under coverage locally hits all new lines in param_and_grad_buffer.py.

<!-- nemo-ci-review-impact:v1 ceiling=moderate -->

One frontier-window logic gap remains, plus the inline constructor-annotation issue. Static review only; tests were not executed.

### Complete holes inside the frontier FSDP unit

The new [completion helper](https://github.com/NVIDIA/Megatron-LM/blob/5e9f02611a020c650402455f678cb18803027a0e/megatron/core/distributed/fsdp/src/megatron_fsdp/param_and_grad_buffer.py#L4700-L4720) assumes that reaching the maximum/minimum selected bucket means all intervening buckets were selected. That is not guaranteed: [parameter groups distinguish dtype](https://github.com/NVIDIA/Megatron-LM/blob/5e9f02611a020c650402455f678cb18803027a0e/megatron/core/distributed/fsdp/src/megatron_fsdp/param_and_grad_buffer.py#L1848-L1884), whereas [collective groups combine buckets by unit and expert status](https://github.com/NVIDIA/Megatron-LM/blob/5e9f02611a020c650402455f678cb18803027a0e/megatron/core/distributed/fsdp/src/megatron_fsdp/param_and_grad_buffer.py#L1999-L2025). A unit registering dense FP32, expert FP32, then dense FP16 parameters can therefore have an interleaved dense collective group.

**Failure:** Use `unit_ids=[0,1,1,1,2]`, sizes `[6,20,6,6,6]`, and bucket groups `{0:[0],1:[1,3],2:[2],3:[1,3],4:[4]}`. With overlap, prefetch, and DP-Outer gathering enabled, requesting bucket 0 with budget 10 makes size extension return `[0,1,3]`. The new helper starts after bucket 3 and stops at unit 2, leaving bucket 2 ungathered. DP-Inner therefore still gathers that part of unit 1 at its own hook instead of prefetching the whole unit. Backward traversal from bucket 4 similarly leaves `[1,3,4]` incomplete.

**Correction:** Fill missing buckets of the frontier unit inside the selected interval, as well as completing its directional tail. Preserve atomic bucket-group inclusion without adding another unit. A small proposed insertion after the existing `while` loop and before its final return is:

```python
        for bucket_id in range(min(result), max(result) + 1):
            if (
                bucket_id not in result
                and parameter_groups[bucket_id].fsdp_unit_id == fsdp_unit_id
            ):
                result.update(self.buffer.bucket_to_bucket_group[bucket_id])
```

The existing `None`-frontier early return should remain. Skipping already-selected buckets is important: otherwise a fine-grained request containing only bucket 3 could unnecessarily expand its existing collective group to bucket 1. This patch is based on source reasoning and must be verified before adoption.

**Acceptance and preservation:** Add proposed forward/backward pipeline regressions with the mapping above. Expect DP-Inner `[0,1,2,3]` forward and `[1,2,3,4]` backward; DP-Outer should include all five buckets in both cases. Also assert that helper-only partial requests `[3]` forward and `[1]` backward remain unchanged. Retain the [existing regression cases](https://github.com/NVIDIA/Megatron-LM/blob/5e9f02611a020c650402455f678cb18803027a0e/tests/unit_tests/distributed/mfsdp_v1/test_mfsdp_fully_shard.py#L275-L431): contiguous forward/backward completion, unchanged non-unit frontiers, zero-size `inner=[0]`/`outer=[0,1,2]`, double-buffered `inner=[0,1,2]`/`outer=[0,1,2,3,4]`, overlap-disabled `inner=[0,1]` with no outer launch, and outer-gather-disabled `inner=[0,1,2,3,4,5]` with no outer launch.

> **Note:** formal approval is not available for this request, so this review is posted as a comment only.

*Review generated by codex. This was a full review. Request a full review with `/review reset=true`.*

<!-- nemo-ci-formal-review:38fea9788be19ced3a306b253400086e75dbeeffb965eb8721267d328cbe3b83:6233bf8c8c401587ca4ae505ea6ef689f011f8e4aaf54a0a8d46840b63c6d66d -->

Add the required constructor return annotation. The new `ToyMoEStack.__init__` omits `-> None`, contrary to the explicit [constructor rule](https://github.com/NVIDIA/Megatron-LM/blob/581248531984920e92f076946ad4629d359442a4/style-guide.md#L16); the inspected formatter/linter configuration does not enforce it.

```suggestion
    def __init__(self, num_blocks: int = 3) -> None:
```

Preserve the default three blocks, configurable block count, and forward chaining. Acceptance is a static check that this signature has the `None` return annotation while the constructor body and `forward` remain unchanged. No test execution is claimed.

@@ -4697,6 +4697,35 @@ def _extend_by_fsdp_units(

+    def _complete_frontier_fsdp_unit(
+        self, bucket_ids: List[int], prefetch_order: PrefetchOrder
+    ) -> List[int]:
+        """Extend a bucket list through the rest of the FSDP unit at its prefetch frontier,
+        including buckets of that unit the window skipped."""
+        parameter_groups = self.buffer.parameter_groups
+        result = set(bucket_ids)
+        step = 1 if prefetch_order == PrefetchOrder.FORWARD_PASS_ORDER else -1
+        frontier = max(result) if step > 0 else min(result)
+        fsdp_unit_id = parameter_groups[frontier].fsdp_unit_id
+        if fsdp_unit_id is None:
+            return list(sorted(result))
+
+        bucket_id = frontier + step
+        while (
+            0 <= bucket_id < len(parameter_groups)
+            and parameter_groups[bucket_id].fsdp_unit_id == fsdp_unit_id
+        ):
+            result.update(self.buffer.bucket_to_bucket_group[bucket_id])
+            bucket_id = (max(result) + 1) if step > 0 else (min(result) - 1)
+
+        # Buckets split by dtype but bucket groups only by expert status, so a selected group
+        # can skip over buckets of the same unit.
+        for bucket_id in range(min(result), max(result) + 1):
+            if bucket_id not in result and parameter_groups[bucket_id].fsdp_unit_id == fsdp_unit_id:
+                result.update(self.buffer.bucket_to_bucket_group[bucket_id])
+
+        return list(sorted(result))

@@ -224,6 +224,271 @@ def extend_by_units(bucket_ids, order, num_units):
     ]
 
 
+def _hfsdp_window_pipeline(unit_ids, sizes, overlap=True, double_buffer=False, bucket_groups=None):
+    """An HFSDP all-gather pipeline whose buckets are replicated on DP-Shard and sharded on
+    DP-Outer. It records the DP-Inner window and the DP-Outer gathers instead of launching
+    them."""
+    pipeline = AllGatherPipeline.__new__(AllGatherPipeline)
+    params = [object() for _ in unit_ids]
+    pipeline.buffer = SimpleNamespace(
+        num_buckets=len(unit_ids),
+        param_to_param_group={param: bucket_id for bucket_id, param in enumerate(params)},
+        parameter_groups=[
+            SimpleNamespace(
+                fsdp_unit_id=unit_id,
+                is_expert_param=False,
+                transpose_weight_buffer=None,
+                hfsdp_helper_wbuf=SimpleNamespace(is_data_distributed=False),
+                model_weight_buffer=SimpleNamespace(bucket_index=SimpleNamespace(size=size)),
+            )
+            for unit_id, size in zip(unit_ids, sizes)
+        ],
+        bucket_to_bucket_group=bucket_groups
+        or {bucket_id: [bucket_id] for bucket_id in range(len(unit_ids))},
+        double_buf_units=set(unit_ids) if double_buffer else set(),
+        ddp_config=SimpleNamespace(
+            fsdp_double_buffer=double_buffer,
+            hfsdp_param_gather_overlap=overlap,
+            outer_dp_sharding_strategy="optim",
+        ),
+        dist_index=SimpleNamespace(
+            use_hybrid_fsdp=True,
+            get_outer_fsdp_group=lambda is_expert_parallel: SimpleNamespace(size=lambda: 2),
+        ),
+    )
+    pipeline.bucket_can_be_released = {}
+    pipeline.bucket_status = {
+        (bucket_id, False): BucketStatus.EMPTY for bucket_id in range(len(unit_ids))
+    }
+    pipeline.recorded = {}
+    pipeline._launch_outer_prefetches = lambda bucket_ids, bwd: pipeline.recorded.update(
+        outer=bucket_ids
+    )
+
+    def group_buckets(bucket_ids):
+        pipeline.recorded["inner"] = bucket_ids
+        return {}
+
+    pipeline._group_buckets = group_buckets
+    return pipeline, params
+
+
+@pytest.mark.parametrize(
+    ("order", "start_buckets", "expected_buckets"),
+    [
+        (PrefetchOrder.FORWARD_PASS_ORDER, [0, 1, 2], [0, 1, 2, 3, 4]),
+        (PrefetchOrder.FORWARD_PASS_ORDER, [0, 1], [0, 1]),
+        (PrefetchOrder.FORWARD_PASS_ORDER, [4, 5], [4, 5]),
+        (PrefetchOrder.FORWARD_PASS_ORDER, [5, 6], [5, 6, 7, 8, 9]),
+        (PrefetchOrder.FORWARD_PASS_ORDER, [7, 8], [7, 8, 9]),
+        (PrefetchOrder.BACKWARD_PASS_ORDER, [4, 5], [2, 3, 4, 5]),
+        (PrefetchOrder.BACKWARD_PASS_ORDER, [9], [6, 7, 8, 9]),
+        (PrefetchOrder.BACKWARD_PASS_ORDER, [2], [2]),
+    ],
+)
+def test_all_gather_pipeline_complete_frontier_unit(order, start_buckets, expected_buckets):
+    """Completing the frontier FSDP unit adds whole bucket groups, stops at the next unit or
+    non-unit bucket, and leaves a non-unit frontier unchanged."""
+    unit_ids = [0, 0, 1, 1, 1, None, 2, 2, 2, 2]
+    bucket_groups = [[0], [1], [2], [3, 4], [3, 4], [5], [6], [7], [8, 9], [8, 9]]
+    pipeline = AllGatherPipeline.__new__(AllGatherPipeline)
+    pipeline.buffer = SimpleNamespace(
+        parameter_groups=[SimpleNamespace(fsdp_unit_id=unit_id) for unit_id in unit_ids],
+        bucket_to_bucket_group=dict(enumerate(bucket_groups)),
+    )
+
+    actual = pipeline._complete_frontier_fsdp_unit(start_buckets, order)
+
+    assert actual == expected_buckets
+
+
+# Unit 1 has a dense bucket group [1, 3] around an expert bucket 2, as when its dense
+# parameters span two dtypes.
+_SKIP_UNIT_IDS = [0, 1, 1, 1, 2]
+_SKIP_BUCKET_GROUPS = {0: [0], 1: [1, 3], 2: [2], 3: [1, 3], 4: [4]}
+
+
+@pytest.mark.parametrize(
+    ("order", "start_buckets", "expected_buckets"),
+    [
+        (PrefetchOrder.FORWARD_PASS_ORDER, [0, 1, 3], [0, 1, 2, 3]),
+        (PrefetchOrder.BACKWARD_PASS_ORDER, [1, 3, 4], [1, 2, 3, 4]),
+        (PrefetchOrder.FORWARD_PASS_ORDER, [3], [3]),
+        (PrefetchOrder.BACKWARD_PASS_ORDER, [1], [1]),
+    ],
+)
+def test_all_gather_pipeline_complete_frontier_unit_fills_skipped_buckets(
+    order, start_buckets, expected_buckets
+):
+    """Buckets of the frontier unit that a non-contiguous bucket group skipped are added;
+    buckets outside the selected span are not."""
+    pipeline = AllGatherPipeline.__new__(AllGatherPipeline)
+    pipeline.buffer = SimpleNamespace(
+        parameter_groups=[SimpleNamespace(fsdp_unit_id=unit_id) for unit_id in _SKIP_UNIT_IDS],
+        bucket_to_bucket_group=_SKIP_BUCKET_GROUPS,
+    )
+
+    actual = pipeline._complete_frontier_fsdp_unit(start_buckets, order)
+
+    assert actual == expected_buckets
+
+
+@pytest.mark.parametrize(
+    ("order", "requested", "inner"),
+    [
+        (PrefetchOrder.FORWARD_PASS_ORDER, 0, [0, 1, 2, 3]),
+        (PrefetchOrder.BACKWARD_PASS_ORDER, 4, [1, 2, 3, 4]),
+    ],
+)
+def test_hfsdp_pipeline_window_fills_skipped_unit_buckets(order, requested, inner):
+    """A size-limited window that selects a non-contiguous bucket group still covers the
+    whole frontier unit."""
+    pipeline, params = _hfsdp_window_pipeline(
+        _SKIP_UNIT_IDS, [6, 20, 6, 6, 6], bucket_groups=_SKIP_BUCKET_GROUPS
+    )
+
+    pipeline.all_gather_params(
+        [params[requested]],
+        prefetch=True,
+        prefetch_order=order,
+        suggested_AG_prefetch_size=10,
+        outer_fsdp_group_param_gather=True,
+    )
+
+    assert pipeline.recorded.get("inner") == inner
+    assert pipeline.recorded.get("outer") == [0, 1, 2, 3, 4]
+
+
+@pytest.mark.parametrize(
+    (
+        "order",
+        "requested",
+        "sizes",
+        "prefetch_size",
+        "overlap",
+        "outer_gather",
+        "double_buffer",
+        "inner",
+        "outer",

<!-- nemo-ci-review-impact:v1 ceiling=moderate -->

One frontier-window logic gap remains, plus the inline constructor-annotation issue. Static review only; tests were not executed.

### Complete holes inside the frontier FSDP unit

The new [completion helper](https://github.com/NVIDIA/Megatron-LM/blob/5e9f02611a020c650402455f678cb18803027a0e/megatron/core/distributed/fsdp/src/megatron_fsdp/param_and_grad_buffer.py#L4700-L4720) assumes that reaching the maximum/minimum selected bucket means all intervening buckets were selected. That is not guaranteed: [parameter groups distinguish dtype](https://github.com/NVIDIA/Megatron-LM/blob/5e9f02611a020c650402455f678cb18803027a0e/megatron/core/distributed/fsdp/src/megatron_fsdp/param_and_grad_buffer.py#L1848-L1884), whereas [collective groups combine buckets by unit and expert status](https://github.com/NVIDIA/Megatron-LM/blob/5e9f02611a020c650402455f678cb18803027a0e/megatron/core/distributed/fsdp/src/megatron_fsdp/param_and_grad_buffer.py#L1999-L2025). A unit registering dense FP32, expert FP32, then dense FP16 parameters can therefore have an interleaved dense collective group.

**Failure:** Use `unit_ids=[0,1,1,1,2]`, sizes `[6,20,6,6,6]`, and bucket groups `{0:[0],1:[1,3],2:[2],3:[1,3],4:[4]}`. With overlap, prefetch, and DP-Outer gathering enabled, requesting bucket 0 with budget 10 makes size extension return `[0,1,3]`. The new helper starts after bucket 3 and stops at unit 2, leaving bucket 2 ungathered. DP-Inner therefore still gathers that part of unit 1 at its own hook instead of prefetching the whole unit. Backward traversal from bucket 4 similarly leaves `[1,3,4]` incomplete.

**Correction:** Fill missing buckets of the frontier unit inside the selected interval, as well as completing its directional tail. Preserve atomic bucket-group inclusion without adding another unit. A small proposed insertion after the existing `while` loop and before its final return is:

```python
        for bucket_id in range(min(result), max(result) + 1):
            if (
                bucket_id not in result
                and parameter_groups[bucket_id].fsdp_unit_id == fsdp_unit_id
            ):
                result.update(self.buffer.bucket_to_bucket_group[bucket_id])
```

The existing `None`-frontier early return should remain. Skipping already-selected buckets is important: otherwise a fine-grained request containing only bucket 3 could unnecessarily expand its existing collective group to bucket 1. This patch is based on source reasoning and must be verified before adoption.

**Acceptance and preservation:** Add proposed forward/backward pipeline regressions with the mapping above. Expect DP-Inner `[0,1,2,3]` forward and `[1,2,3,4]` backward; DP-Outer should include all five buckets in both cases. Also assert that helper-only partial requests `[3]` forward and `[1]` backward remain unchanged. Retain the [existing regression cases](https://github.com/NVIDIA/Megatron-LM/blob/5e9f02611a020c650402455f678cb18803027a0e/tests/unit_tests/distributed/mfsdp_v1/test_mfsdp_fully_shard.py#L275-L431): contiguous forward/backward completion, unchanged non-unit frontiers, zero-size `inner=[0]`/`outer=[0,1,2]`, double-buffered `inner=[0,1,2]`/`outer=[0,1,2,3,4]`, overlap-disabled `inner=[0,1]` with no outer launch, and outer-gather-disabled `inner=[0,1,2,3,4,5]` with no outer launch.
